50307248393748.title: Pokémon Center UK:
50307248393748.body: We are currently experiencing delays affecting some orders for our UK customers. These orders may take longer than usual to process, dispatch, and deliver. We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

37286495522452.title: Pokémon Center Virtual Queue
37286495522452.body:
Customer support agents are not able to assist with questions or issues with the virtual queue. If you contact support regarding the virtual queue, your inquiry may be closed without a response since we are unable to assist.

Pokémon Center uses a virtual queue to access the site in order to help keep everyone browsing and shopping smoothly.

  • If you are currently in line to enter Pokémon Center, please keep the virtual queue window open. 
  • Do not refresh your browser or move away from the page. You will be redirected to the site automatically when it is your turn to enter.
  • Estimated wait times may vary depending on the number of people interested in visiting Pokémon Center. It is normal to be in the virtual queue for extended periods of time depending on site traffic.
  • Opening Pokémon Center in multiple tabs, using alternate links, or attempting any workarounds will not help you bypass the virtual queue, and those actions may result in other technical errors.

Pokémon Center uses the virtual queue as one measure of many to help ensure that everyone has a smooth browsing and shopping experience and does not necessarily mean a product is launching. Waiting in line does not guarantee product availability, and some products may be out of stock or unavailable for purchase.

Do you have a technical issue?

If you encounter any technical issues, please try the troubleshooting steps below:

  • Only shop within your region. For example, if you are in the United States, you must use the US site.
  • Refrain from using a VPN.
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies.
  • Adhere to Pokémon Center purchase limits, which are displayed on the product page.
  • Do not attempt to check out with preorder and non-preorder items in your cart at the same time.
  • Be sure that your billing and shipping addresses are accurate.

360000380473.title: Where does Pokémon Center Ship?
360000380473.body: Navigate to Pokémon Center and scroll to "Shipping" at the bottom of the page to see where we ship in your region.

360000554174.title: Why was my order canceled?
360000554174.body: The most common reasons why an order gets canceled or partially canceled is if a product is no longer available or the credit card on file has changed since the order was placed. Note that an entire order may be canceled if even one item in the order is no longer available.

4410136975892.title: Pokémon Center UK FAQ
4410136975892.body:
What payment methods are accepted?

Pokémon Center UK customers may use the following methods of payment:

  • Visa
  • MasterCard
  • PayPal
  • American Express
  • Apple Pay

Please note: All transactions with Pokémon Center UK are charged in Great British Pounds (GBP).

For the full list of our accepted payment methods across each Pokémon Center regional website, please see our support article.

Are there gifting or gift-wrap options available?

Pokémon Center UK does not support gifting or gift-wrap options at this time.

Can I use my Pokémon Center account from other regions to access the UK site?

Pokémon Center UK shares credentials only with Pokémon Center Germany. 

  • Pokémon Center accounts registered to other regions cannot be used to log in to Pokémon Center UK at this time.
  • It’s important to note that orders for all regions are only visible on their respective sites.

How much does shipping cost?

Orders £20 and over

Free shipping for all orders £20 and over.

Orders under £20

£5 flat fee, regardless of size or value.

Note: Any shipping costs will be added to your order at checkout.

Where does Pokémon Center UK ship?

Orders from Pokémon Center UK are only shipped to addresses in the United Kingdom. We are unable to ship to PO boxes and BFPO addresses.

For more information, please see our Shipping Policy.

How long does delivery take?

Pokémon Center UK aims to deliver orders within 3 to 6 working days after an order has been placed.

For more information, please see our Shipping Policy.

Can I track my order?

Yes. Please check your shipping confirmation email for a tracking link.

You may also access order tracking if you check your order on the Pokémon Center UK website.

How can I return a product?

Please refer to our Return Policy. 

Are all products available in every region?

Not all Pokémon Center products are available in every region. We recommend checking the site frequently for updates.

How can I sign up to receive offers and promotions?

To receive marketing communications, including email messages with the latest news, offers, promotions, events, and games from The Pokémon Company International, please sign up for a Pokémon Trainer Central account.

In addition, you may sign up for our email newsletter.

360051729272.title: How do I select a different country on Pokémon Center?
360051729272.body:
To change the country, scroll to the bottom of any Pokémon Center page and select the country displayed on the bottom left.

And, under Select your region, select the region you want.

Alternatively, you can navigate directly to the regional Pokémon Center sites via the URLs below.

  • US: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
  • Canada: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/en-ca
  • UK: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/en-gb
  • Germany: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/en-de
  • Australia: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/en-au
  • New Zealand: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/en-nz

51588609258644.title: 30th Celebration TCG FAQ
51588609258644.body:
We are excited to share information to help make your 30th Celebration shopping experience as smooth as possible and to help address some issues that may occur during periods of high traffic on our website.

What is the virtual queue and why am I waiting to enter Pokémon Center?

You may experience longer than normal wait times in our virtual queue if the site has a high volume of traffic, which is expected during the launch of 30th Celebration products.

If you are in line to enter Pokémon Center, please keep the window open to stay in the queue. Do not refresh your browser. You will automatically be directed to the site when it is your turn.

For any other questions, please see, Pokémon Center Virtual Queue.

What should I do if I experience issues accessing the Pokémon Center website?

For a smooth shopping experience, please see the below instructions and tips:

  • Turn off your VPN if you are using one.
  • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
  • If you experience issues accessing the site, try again using a different browser and/or device.
  • You can also try using a different internet connection: if you are using Wi-Fi, try a mobile data connection, or vice versa.

High-traffic scenarios may result in intermittent site access issues for some customers that can’t be solved by our team or by customer support. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Why can’t I check out?

For a smooth shopping experience, please follow the guidance and tips below.

  • Adhere to purchase limits.
  • Do not attempt to check out with a preorder and non-preorder item in your cart at the same time.
  • Ensure your billing and shipping addresses are accurate.
  • Manually fill out all information fields on the checkout pages as autofill can cause issues.
  • Create an account or log in to your account instead of ordering as a guest.
  • Try a different credit or debit card. For more on payment information please see the article, "What payment forms are accepted on pokemoncenter.com?"
  • Use your own trusted and accurate address rather than an alternate or forwarding address.

Due to the high demand for 30th Celebration products, it is possible that items may go out of stock before you are able to complete your purchase, which may result in an error message. It is also possible that the high volume of traffic may result in some customers experiencing error messages.

We are working to improve our systems during these high-volume launches, but customer support is not able to investigate individual errors during high traffic scenarios.

Why haven’t I received a confirmation email after placing my order?

While confirmation emails are typically sent immediately after an order is placed, they can be delayed during periods of high traffic. Please note that it can take up to 48 hours for the email to arrive.

We also recommend checking your spam folder for your confirmation email, in case your email service provider or email filter identified it as spam.

If you placed your order under your Pokémon Center account, you can log in at any time to see the status and tracking for each order in your order history.

If it has been more than 48 hours since you placed your order and you still have not received a confirmation email, please reach out to us for assistance.

When is Pokémon Center going to restock 30th Celebration products?

We are not able to share whether 30th Celebration products will be restocked or when they will be restocked.

38669040904212.title: How do I contact Pokémon Center Support?
38669040904212.body:
If you can’t find the information that you are looking for on our support site, please find your region below to get in touch with someone to help!

Pokémon Center US, Canada, and UK

Chat

Agents are available 24/7 to assist with your issue. 

Select the chat icon on the bottom right of your screen to start a new chat.

  • Chat is a great way to get help with questions about your order. When you start a chat, you will be presented with various types of issues and by selecting the one most related to your question, our agents will have better information to assist you more quickly.
  • Occasionally, more complex cases will be moved from chat to email, but rest assured we are doing our best to assist.

Email

If you prefer to submit an email ticket, an agent will typically respond within 24 hours. 

Submit an email ticket here.

  • Any issue that we can help with can be assisted with via email!
  • Some issues may receive a much faster automated response if we think we know the answer based on your question, but you can always respond if we didn't get it right.
  • Occasionally, email responses will be delayed due to a high volume of inquiries, but rest assured we are working as quickly as possible to respond. 

Do you offer phone support? 

At this time, Pokémon Center does not offer phone support. 

We are focused on providing accurate answers as quickly as possible, and we believe that chat and email are the best ways to accomplish this. We also don’t like waiting on hold any more than you do!

Need help with a Pokémon vending machine?

Check out our Pokémon Vending Machine FAQ where you can find answers to frequently asked questions as well as contact information. You can also check out our Pokémon Vending Machine Locator to see if there’s one near you!

 


Pokémon Center Germany, Australia, and New Zealand

Customer support in our Pokémon Center Germany, Australia, and New Zealand regions is managed by our global fulfilment partner, Global-e.

  • For customers located in Germany, please see your regional Help Center.
  • For customers located in Australia and New Zealand, please see your regional Help Center.

35134190572564.title: Pokémon Center: Early Access FAQ
35134190572564.body:
What is Early Access?

The Pokémon Center Early Access program allows selected customers an opportunity to purchase popular items before they are more widely released.

Who is eligible for Early Access?

Customers subscribed to the Pokémon Center newsletter and who meet specific criteria are eligible to be selected for early access. Note that Pokémon Center does not share eligibility criteria.

Customers do not need an existing Pokémon Center account to receive an invitation. However, customers are required to log in to or register an account with the same email address from the invitation before checking out using the early access invitation link.

Currently, only customers in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom are eligible to receive a chance to participate in Early Access.  

Please note the following:

  • Not all newsletter subscribers are eligible.
  • Meeting eligibility criteria does not guarantee a chance to participate.
  • Receiving an invitation to Early Access does not guarantee future access.
  • Creating multiple subscriptions or using different email addresses does not increase the likelihood of receiving an invitation to participate in the Early Access program. Such actions may result in the invitation being voided. 

How do I know if I received an Early Access invitation?

If you are selected, you will receive an email containing a unique invitation link for early access to one or more items. If you are not selected, you will not receive any email regarding early access, but this does not necessarily mean that you will not be selected in the future.

The invitation link is unique to you, and it is not transferable. The link may be disabled in cases of suspected misuse or policy violations. 

What items are included in the Early Access Program?

Any item, including preorder items, may be included in the Early Access program. Please note that Pokémon Center Support is unable to share information regarding which items are included in the Early Access program.

Do I have to purchase Early Access items immediately?

Items included in the Early Access program are generally popular, so it is recommended to use your invitation sooner rather than later if you are interested in the item(s).

If you need more time after you open your unique invitation link, you can close your browser and reopen the invitation link provided it has not yet expired.

Please note the following:

  • The invitation email will contain an expiration date for the invitation link.
  • Early Access items are available while supplies last, until the expiration date.

Will Early Access items sell out?

Early Access does not guarantee availability. Item quantities are limited and available while supplies last.

What if I'm not signed in to my Pokémon Center account?

If you are not signed in to your Pokémon Center account when you open your unique invitation link, you will see a message under the Add to Cart or Add to Basket button prompting you to sign in using the email address the invitation link was sent to. If you do not have a Pokémon Center account, you may create one after receiving an invitation. Your Early Access offer will remain valid through this process.

Can I use multiple browsers or devices to redeem my Early Access offer?

Using multiple devices or browsers to open your Early Access invitation link may impact your ability to complete your Early Access order. We recommend using only one device and browser to open the invitation link, shop, and check out.

Can I only use my Early Access invitation once?

Yes. Each invitation link is both unique and single-use.

Can I share my unique invitation link with a friend?

Sharing your unique invitation link is not supported.

24128350732820.title: Pokémon Center Preorder FAQ
24128350732820.body:
Select merchandise is available to preorder on Pokémon Center prior to their release date. See Estimated Preorder Release Dates for a list of estimated shipment dates for Pokémon Center preorders.

When you place a preorder, you are authorizing Pokémon Center to take a future payment using the payment method details you provided during the checkout process.

A valid credit card is required to place preorders, and an authorization may be held until the product is available to ship. Charges will not post to the account until the item ships. Orders may be canceled if the credit card on file is not valid at the time of shipment.

Select promotions or Gifts-with-Purchase may not be eligible for preorders.

 

 

Frequently asked questions

  • How do I preorder an item on Pokémon Center?
  • When will I be charged for a preorder?
  • What types of payment methods can be used for preorders?
  • When will my preorder ship?
  • How do I cancel my preorder?
  • Can I change the address on my preorder?
  • My payment method has insufficient funds to cover the preorder. What do I do?
  • Can I preorder different preorder items in the same transaction?
  • Why was my preorder canceled?

 

How do I preorder an item on Pokémon Center?

Items on Pokémon Center that are eligible for preorder will have "Preorder: Add to Cart/Basket" available on its product page. Proceed with adding the item to the cart and follow the steps to checkout. 

If preordering multiple items, please place separate orders for each preorder item.

 

What types of payment methods can be used for preorders?

Valid credit or debit cards are accepted. Gift cards, Apple Pay and PayPal cannot be used for preorders.

 

When will I be charged for a preorder?

An initial authorization charge will be placed on your payment method when your preorder is placed. This is to ensure that the payment method being used is valid. You may see this authorization charge drop after 5-7 business days.

We will not charge your card for your order until it has shipped. However, a reauthorization will appear 3-5 business days prior to shipping to ensure that the payment method is still valid.

Authorizations may last up to 30 days, depending on the financial institution. If you have questions about specific transactions on your account, please contact your bank.

 

When will my preorder ship?

See Estimated Preorder Release Dates for the list of estimated shipment dates for Pokémon Center preorders. When your order is ready to ship, you should receive a shipping confirmation email that has the tracking number for your order.

We do not have exact dates for preorder shipment or delivery. While Pokémon Center works diligently to ship products as close to the release date as possible, shipping times are subject to transit delays such as those due to weather.

 

How do I cancel my preorder?

You can only cancel a preorder before it is processed. Once your preorder has been processed and your payment method has been reauthorized, it cannot be canceled.

 

To cancel your preorder, follow the steps below:

  1. From the Order Details page, select the Cancel Preorder button.
  2. When prompted, confirm you want to cancel your preorder. On the Order Details page, the status will change to Canceled.
  3. You will be sent an email confirming your cancelation.

 

If you checked out as a Guest, you can still manage your preorder by visiting the Order Status page.

  • US Order Status
  • Canada Order Status
  • UK Order Status

 

From the Order Status page, enter your Order ID and postal code. Your postal code must match the one used when placing your order. You should now have the option to cancel your preorder.

 

Please note the following:

  • You can only cancel a preorder before it is processed. After requesting cancelation, please allow up to 24 hours for your order status to update.
  • You will not be charged for a canceled preorder, but your card may show a temporary pending authorization hold. Funds will return to your account when the financial institution releases the hold.
  • If you cancel a preorder item, we cannot guarantee the same item will be available for preorder again.
  • Excluding final sale items, you may return any unwanted items that you were not able to cancel. See How do I return item(s) for a refund? for more information.

 

Can I change the address on my preorder?

Pokémon Center is unable to provide address changes for any preorders.

If you would like to change your address and the product is still available, you may cancel your preorder and place a new one with the proper address. Please note that we cannot guarantee that the product will be available for a new order.

 

I need to update my payment method. What do I do?

Once preorders begin processing, our team will make several attempts to charge your original payment method. To ensure you receive your items and your order is not canceled, please make sure you have sufficient funds available, and your payment method has not expired.

If we are unable to capture funds, you will receive an email with instructions on how to change your payment method. Please note that any change in payment method including transferring or depositing funds will result in a successful transaction and we will not be able to cancel your order. If changes are unable to be completed by the time preorders begin shipping, this will result in a canceled order.

 

I'm getting an error when updating my payment method. What do I do?

If you are receiving a red  error message (similar to the one displayed below) after adding your new payment method, try refreshing the page and then re-entering your payment method.

 

Can I preorder different preorder items in the same transaction?

If a product is available for preorder, you may order it with other preorder items with the same release date. Additionally, you cannot place a single order that contains both a preorder and non-preorder item.

If you wish to order preorder items that have different release dates or a preorder and non-preorder item, please place those orders separately.

 

Why was my preorder canceled?

Preorder cancelations occur whenever there is an issue with the billing or shipping information. If our system is unable to authorize your payment method when preorders are processed for shipping, your order will be canceled and cannot be reinstated.
